parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN steele_wr.begin_model_call($1, $3) ELSE 'not-calling' END AS begun
SELECT CASE WHEN $7::boolean THEN steele_wr.save_model_output($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::numeric, $6) END AS saved, $3::text AS raw, $8::text AS fail_reason

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $json.failReason ? [$json.attempt, null, null, null, null, null, false, $json.failReason] : [$json.attempt, $json.model, $json.raw, JSON.stringify($json.usage), $json.costUsd, $json.finishReason, true, null] }}

parameters.query: SELECT CASE $1 WHEN 'fail' THEN steele_wr.fail_attempt($2, $3) WHEN 'save' THEN steele_wr.save_article($4, $2, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb) ELSE jsonb_build_object('attempt', $2) END AS outcome

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.outcome, $json.attempt ?? '', $json.reason ?? null, $json.articleId ?? null, $json.title ?? null, $json.subtitle ?? null, $json.markdown ?? null, $json.articleJson ? JSON.stringify($json.articleJson) : null] }}

meta.description: One bounded writing attempt: the pinned source version and prompt, one model call (fake or live, budget-checked) or reuse of saved output, then article-v1 validation, deterministic Markdown and an immutable saved article. No research, judge or correction loop.
